rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes stronger ICM than TE, but it overstates visible expansion/hatching certainty from this single image and introduces some ambiguity about stage 4 vs 5.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve/yield, tubal factor, prior miscarriage, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with prognosis appropriately driven by maternal age despite decent morphology; only minor issue is some inconsistency around exact blastocyst stage/hatching interpretation.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF counseling, including emphasis on age, single embryo transfer, luteal support, and hydrosalpinx evaluation; minor deviation is somewhat loose handling of stage 4 versus 5 terminology.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx assessment, luteal support, and discussion of PGT-A/embryo banking, though some recommendations remain broad rather than highly case-specific.
